comment: Expected failures of cells with a TypeScript client or agent (programs/node). See README.md in this directory.

expectations.reason: zToolCall reads status (and kind, :2359) with defaultOnError over the closed zToolCallStatus union (:117), so an unknown status becomes undefined: the turn goes on but the raw value interop_future_status is lost
zPlan reads entries with vecSkipError, and zPlanEntry's priority and status are closed unions (:2408-2409, :2381, :2393), so the entry with unknown values is dropped: the plan arrives empty
zAnnotations reads audience with vecSkipError over the closed zRole union (:127), so the TypeScript agent's handler sees ["user"]: the unknown Role interop_future_role is dropped, not kept
